heroImageAlt: Guests relaxing on the trampoline net of a catamaran
title: Recalibration Expedition
subtitle: You only choose the dates & the people. Then we take it from there.
intro: A private sailing expedition crafted for people who want to disconnect with their own people, at a pace nobody else is setting.
onBoard:
**CREW**

* Skipper + Trained Eagle Ray Expedition Leader + Chef (adaptable)

**ITINERARY**

* Daily programme, tailored to the group’s mood & weather

**SAILBOAT & EQUIPMENT**

* The whole boat booked exclusively for your group
* Snorkelling equipment
* Fishing kit
* 2 paddleboards
* 1 kayak
* 1 dinghy
* Beach equipment (chairs, sunshade, etc.)

**MEALS & DRINKS**

* All meals on board
* Non-alcoholic drinks

**TRANSFERS**

* La Paz Airport ↔ marina, on arrival and departure

**EXTRAS**

* Diesel
* Navigation permits and national park entry fees
* Starlink Wi-Fi on board
* Navigation licence and national park entry fees
onBoardImageAlt: Included items in the sailing expedition
notOnBoard:
* Crew tips (10–15% recommended)
* Flights to La Paz
* Alcoholic drinks, to be selected from a menu prior to the trip
* Scuba diving: price on request depending on the number of dives and the group's qualifications
* Other guided activities, quoted separately
* Personal travel insurance
notOnBoardImageAlt: Not included items in the sailing expedition

seo.title: Recalibration Expedition — Eagle Ray Expeditions
seo.description: A private, slow-paced sailing expedition in La Paz. You choose the dates and the people, and we plan the rest.
